landing.title: Track your gut symptoms and find out what triggers them
landing.lead: {brand} is a simple diary for people with irritable bowel syndrome (IBS). Log what you eat, your symptoms, when you feel stressed and how you sleep in a few seconds. After two weeks you'll see what your symptoms seem to relate to.

one.title: Log
one.body: Choose Food, Symptom or Stress. The time is already filled in. An entry takes about ten seconds.

two.title: See your patterns
two.body: After about two weeks, {brand} shows whether your symptoms mostly relate to food, stress or sleep.

three.title: Discuss it
three.body: Take your overview to your GP or a gastro dietitian. You can export everything as a file.

meal.title: Food
meal.body: Meals with tags such as onion/garlic, dairy, wheat or legumes, and the portion size.

symptom.title: Symptoms
symptom.body: Pain, bloating, cramps or diarrhoea, with severity from 0 to 10 and the Bristol stool scale.

stress.title: Stress
stress.body: How tense you are and why. Including stress beforehand, out of worry about symptoms.

sleep.title: Sleep and day
sleep.body: How you slept, water, movement and, if you like, data from your smartwatch.

landing.aboutBody1: Irritable bowel syndrome (IBS) is a common condition of the gut. Symptoms include abdominal pain, bloating, cramps, diarrhoea or constipation. Symptoms often vary from day to day.
landing.aboutBody2: What triggers symptoms differs per person. Certain foods (such as onion, garlic, dairy or wheat), stress and poor sleep can play a role. Gut and brain influence each other: tension can worsen symptoms, and symptoms cause tension. A diary helps you see your personal pattern.
landing.aboutMore: Read more about IBS on the NHS website
landing.loopTitle: Stress and gut symptoms reinforce each other
landing.loopBody: Tension can make your gut more restless, and a restless gut causes tension. Sometimes before anything happens, such as before a train journey or an appointment. {brand} tracks this ‘stress beforehand’ separately, so you can see the connection.
landing.privacyBody: Everything you enter is stored only on your own phone. There is no account, no server keeping your data and no trackers. We cannot see your data.

privacyPoints.export: Export and erase whenever you want

landing.insightBody: No complicated charts, but a summary of what your symptoms seem to relate to, with how much data it is based on. {brand} shows patterns and never diagnoses.

faq.a1: Tracking and insights are free, without subscriptions or ads. Only the PDF report for your doctor or dietitian costs a small one-time fee (pay with iDEAL).
faq.a2: No. {brand} shows patterns in what you track yourself. Always discuss what you see with your GP or a (gastro) dietitian before changing your diet or lifestyle.
faq.a3: Only in the browser on your own device. Nothing is sent to a server. Make a backup now and then via Settings, because clearing your browser data erases it.
faq.a4: The first patterns appear after about two weeks. The longer and more completely you track, the more reliable the insights.
faq.a5: Yes. After your first visit you can add {brand} to your home screen and everything works offline.
faq.q6: Does this help with the low-FODMAP diet?
faq.a6: {brand} can help you track how you respond to foods, for example during reintroduction. Preferably follow a low-FODMAP diet with guidance from a gastro dietitian.

landing.finalBody: Free, no account and private on your own phone.
landing.footerDisclaimer: {brand} gives insight into patterns and is not a medical device. It does not diagnose or give treatment advice. Persistent or new symptoms? Contact your GP.

privacy.title: Privacy, in plain language
privacy.intro: {brand} was built on one promise: what you track about your gut stays yours. Here's exactly what that means.

where.title: Where is my data?
where.body: Everything you enter (meals, symptoms, stress, sleep and notes) is stored in your browser's storage on this device (IndexedDB). It is never sent to us or anyone else.

account.title: Do I need an account?
account.body: No. There is no account, no email and no password, so we can't see who you are either.

analytics.title: Do you measure anything?
analytics.body: Only on the public pages (the home page and this privacy statement) do we count visits, anonymously and without cookies (Vercel Web Analytics). Inside the app we measure nothing at all, and your health data never ends up in those statistics.

backup.title: What if I lose my phone?
backup.body: Because we don't store your data, we can't restore it either. Make a backup now and then via Settings → Export. {brand} will gently remind you.

control.title: Can I erase everything?
control.body: Yes. Settings → Erase everything removes all data from this device at once. Clearing your browser data works too.

medical.title: Not medical advice
medical.body: {brand} shows patterns but does not diagnose or give treatment advice. Discuss what you see with your GP or a (gastro) dietitian.

payment.title: Paying for the report
payment.body: You pay for the PDF report with iDEAL through our payment partner Mollie. Mollie processes your payment details (such as your bank and IBAN) under its own privacy policy. We only receive whether the payment succeeded. Your health data is never included: the report is created on your own device.

s1.title: A diary for your gut
s1.body: Log what you eat, when your gut acts up and when you're stressed. It takes a few taps each time.

s2.title: After two weeks, patterns appear
s2.body: {brand} compares your symptoms with your food, stress and sleep. The more you log, the clearer the picture.

s3.title: Everything stays on this device
s3.body: No account, no server, no trackers. Make a backup now and then, because we can't restore anything for you.

s4.title: Insight, not a diagnosis
s4.body: {brand} shows what seems related. That is not medical advice. Discuss patterns with your GP or a (gastro) dietitian before changing anything.

s5.title: What do you want to track?
s5.body: Pick the food tags you'll use often. They'll appear first. You can always change this later.
